name: ecosoft
description: Plataforma de gestión de subastas energéticas y contratos PPA para la CNE.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build --workspace @ecosoft/shared && npm run db:generate
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @ecosoft/api & npm run dev --workspace @ecosoft/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ecosoft/shared && npm run build --workspace @ecosoft/api && npm run build --workspace @ecosoft/web
